bestBets.overview: SARABI was an eye-catcher first up. She settled at the rear, found plenty of traffic in the straight and was still only narrowly beaten. The rise to 1400m looks ideal and if she's within striking distance on straightening she'll be hard to hold out. GAINTREE led and dug deep late to get the job done first up. She should derive plenty of benefit from that outing and Pike retains the ride. PROPERATA is rock-hard fit and racing well. He was narrowly edged out by Gaintree last start. He just needs luck from a sticky draw to play a part. MARCOS should appreciate the rise in trip.

raceTips.comment: Sarabi is going to relish the rise to 1400m. Her effort first up over 1000m was terrific. She settled last and took some time to get warm and then had to deal with traffic problems halfway down the straight. When clear though, she rocketed to the line to just miss but she was a tragedy beaten. Breeding suggests the rise in trip will suit. Hell of a win by Gaintree last start. Presenting first up at Belmont, she led, with Properata keeping her company to her outside throughout the race. They came away from the field to fight it out and even though it looked as if Properata would go right past, the filly kicked on gamely and held on. She'll only improve from that given she was on resumption, and in this field, maps the leader again. Marcos is rock hard fit and racing well. He's hit the line sweetly in all three starts this prep and now gets the blinkers on.

SARABI arguably should have won first-up. She had extreme difficulty navigating a clear pathway in the home straight and still got within a head of Spinarella and Manhattan Squeeze late. She’s 4 weeks between runs and she’s 1000m to 1400m in one step, so there’s definitely an element of caution but don’t think any of these are our real A-Grader 3 year olds (at this stage) and with clear galloping room she could be hard to hold out late. GAINTREE trialled well, won well and will again park up over the speed and get every chance. This race runs deeper and she has an extra 2kg to lump after being right place, right time on the inside fast lane a fortnight ago. MARCOS nearly fell last start just as he was building into the race. Shades on will hopefully straighten him up. PROPERATA has come back bigger and stronger this time around.

bestBets.overview: ESPRESSO TIME is flying this time in and shooting for a winning hat-trick. Expect him to fire across from his wide draw, park right over the speed and prove hard to run down. SO SI GOD raced a little flat first up. She is better than that, will appreciate the rise in trip and was scratched from a winnable race on Wednesday to be saved for this. FRAPPUCCINO was sound first up and has claims if he gets any luck from a wide draw. BLUE CAN TALK attacks this off a strong midweek win.

raceTips.comment: Espresso Time will have plenty of fans after two straight wins. He's shown his versatility in those, arriving from the second half of the field two back before leading and winning with ease here last start. Adding merit to the performance was that she was pestered by one out wider in transit but still bolted in, whereas the other horse dropped out in the straight. The race shape was against So Si God last start, who was back/wide first up in a race which was dominated by the on pacers. She found the line nicely from where she was but was never a winning threat. Expect her to improve with the run under her belt and 1200m will suit nicely. Gold Flakes was ok here last start after settling second last but made steady ground without ever proving to be a threat. I think she found the 1000m too nippy from where she was in the field. The 1200m she sees here looks to be more her go. Frappuccino ran well fresh and  enjoys racing at this circuit.

SO SI GOD trialled up like a horse who would be winning first-up, however, she went to 1000m and never travelled at any stage and failed to let down as expected. She did return with the tongue over the bit (gear change: bit lifter on) and now she’s out to a more suitable 1200m second-up. Scratched from a 6-horse field on Wednesday in favour of this race and it looks winnable for her. Her minors to Searchin’ Times, Urquharts Bluff, Wheely and Peaceful Ruler as a 3 year old is superior form to what the majority of these bring to the race. Hoping she can bounce back quickly. ESPRESSO TIME sat wide throughout first-up when beaten a head, sat wide throughout second-up when breaking his maiden and then backed it up with a solid all the way C1 win. BLUE CAN TALK was ridden cold first-up and it paid dividends, she went to a whole new level. GOLD FLAKES had bar plates added last week and ran below her usual honest, consistent best. Wary that they’re still on.

bestBets.overview: MIND FIELD is a talented type who attacks this first up with the benefit of a very impressive trial win. From his inside draw he should get a soft run in transit and if the gaps appear he will be hard to hold out late. TRULY LOYAL shook off his maiden with a strong first-up win. He's a nice type who should work his way through the grades quickly. GOD'S GATE is on the seven-day back-up after an unlucky run here last Saturday. He is rock-hard fit and racing well. CANNYKEV improves off his first-up run and has claims.

raceTips.comment: TRULY LOYAL made his Michael Grantham debut 10 days ago in a 1200m maiden at Belmont Park and really powered to and through the line late. Bob Peters has quite often taken these lightly raced 3 and 4 year olds straight to a 60+ Graduation from their maiden wins and he has done it with great effect. Keeps him low in the weights, draws to get the right run midfield with cover and think he’s more than capable of making the step. GOD’S GATE should have won last week. Through no fault of Stevie Parnham there was just nowhere to go at critical points in the race and once he got clear he was charging. On the 7-day spin he can make amends. MIND FIELD could not have trialled up any better for his return and with Six Shooter coming out of that trial and winning a 66+ last weekend it only makes it look even more impressive. CANNYKEV tries hard.

Mind Field is a smart gelding who has good races in his future. He has been freshened up since a fast finishing win at this track in July. His recent trial was excellent. He circled the field and dispatched of his rivals with ease. It was soft and he won the heat by over three lengths with plenty left in the locker. With even luck from barrier one, he'll be hard to beat. Truly Loyal is another promising gelding who impressed in his last start win. With Pike aboard jumping from a good gate, he should be within striking distance turning for home. Cannykev was sound first up. Fitter for it, he boasts strong second up form and races well around this circuit. God's Gate best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: SWINGMAN should be primed for this assignment at his third run back from a spell. He led and wasn't beaten far last start. Expect him to park right over the speed and be hard to run down. The stablemate NICCIMOTA produced a big first-up win where she tracked wide throughout then last time she ran a strong second behind a talented type. No surprise to see her fire straight to the front from her inside draw. DEVINE BELIEF has plenty of ability when right. Two runs in 18 months is the query on his chances. PIN DEEP next best.

raceTips.comment: PIN DEEP stepped into the Jolly Beggar Stakes last weekend and was hammered in betting. He underperformed after racing really keenly through the early and middle stages but hopefully 7 days later he can park and ride behind the Taylor pair and enjoy the run of the race. Looks a nice set up for him to bounce back. NICCIMOTA was simply no match for the extremely speedy Dawn Dancer last start but is quite nicely placed here stepping up into 72+ company. She’s dropping down 5.5kg and that might just encourage them to use her high cruising speed to advantage. SWINGMAN is racing with great consistency but he’s always been vulnerable at 1000m. Has worn blinkers at all 13 career runs, now winkers on Saturday. DEVINE BELIEF has been very sparingly raced over the last few years as the stable battles her well documented hoof troubles.

Pretty even bunch do battle here. Devine Belief stretched the legs in a recent Lark Hill trial, and did all that she needed to. The lightly raced mare goes well fresh and is a five-time winner over this 1000m trip. Drawn ideally and Paul Harvey has options. She has the pace to lead but I envisage the horse will settle down on the rail, on the back of Avoidance, who has plenty of early speed. Swingman has come back from a spell in good touch. He was brave last start, finishing half a length behind the winner. Fitter for it and he gets a couple of key gear changes. The consistent Pin Deep was sound in a stronger race last start. He crossed the line with Swingman two back. Niccimota is well weighted with just 52.5kg on her back, dropping from 58kg last start when running third over this track/trip.

bestBets.overview: DIRTY HABITS should improve sharply on his effort here last week. He was off a five-week let-up, was over an unsuitable trip and wasn't beaten far despite getting little room in the straight. The rise to 1600m looks ideal and he will carry only 53.5kg after the claim for Holly Nottle. THE ROCKET is flying this time in and attacks this off back-to-back dominant on-speed wins. He is the one to run down. YES I KNOW is another runner on the seven-day back-up after going down by an eyelash last Saturday. He drops in class but rises substantially in weight. COSMIC GEM next best.

raceTips.comment: Dirty Habits didn't have a whole lot of luck at Belmont last start when a close up 5th. He was caught on the fence behind horses and needed to shift course about 300m out when his initial passage through closed. He ran on strongly to just miss the placings. Given he's a winner over 1700m, the rise from 1300m to the mile is going to suit him ideally. Cosmic Gem may need a touch of luck from the draw but he is pretty versatile in where he can settle. Strong win last start at this track, winning by 3L. Importantly, he has won at the mile, saluting on his home deck (Albany) last prep. Yes I Know seldom runs poorly and is suited dropping in grade. He rocketed home last start, hit the front late before the winner got him by the barest possible margin. Smaller chances given to Streak of God and The Rocket.

YES I KNOW is on the 7-day spin dropping out of a 72+ where he went to the line locked together with The Crimson Pirate. He has to lump 60.5kg and that’s the sticking point but from the draw he should be afforded an economical passage in running and he’s already shown in his four runs in WA that he’ll be working his way through the grades. THE ROCKET has really come of age this preparation after beginning the campaign a 7-start maiden. He broke his maiden by just over 2L and then backed it up with another dominant all the way C3 win. 1300 to 1400 and now to 1600m, if they allow him to work his way to the top then he should be very competitive again. COSMIC GEM had nothing go his way first-up or second-up in respective forgive runs. Bolted in third-up. DIRTY HABITS found traffic last week and has a real X-Factor about him.

bestBets.overview: DEEL HER IN was enormous in defeat last start. Slow away, she settled at the rear and flooded home late and just missed. If she can step away cleanly and utilise her good draw she will take plenty of beating. SEARCHIN' TIMES was good last start coming off a seven-week let-up and finding the line well after meeting traffic in the straight. SILENT DIVA is on the seven-day back-up after a deserved win at this track and distance last Saturday. BRAVE SPIRIT next best.

raceTips.comment: SEARCHIN’ TIMES just has to navigate barrier 1. The last time she drew in the box seat she was left waiting and looking for runs until the race was all over so there’s definitely a small element of unknown, however, she has also won a race leading so if she was to jump they could definitely entertain riding her like the best horse in the race and taking luck out of the equation. Last start she was 7 weeks between runs and looked to have plenty to offer in the straight, just nowhere to go. A fortnight later she drops 3.5kg and is a nice mare on the rise. SILENT DIVA got the job done last weekend and had been knocking on the door all prep. Was the win of a mare who can go on with it. DEEL HER IN is ready now and this is the right grade for her with the weight relief. REFEMME NO ANGEL jumped a short priced favourite last start and never saw daylight at any stage.

Deel Her In was a pretty straightforward entry into the black book after her enormous effort here two weeks ago. She was shuffled back to last on the turn and was near the fence but with a wall of horses in front of her, Steve Parnham had to come right around the field. She sprouted wings in the straight but just couldn't reel in the winner. She was really the only horse to make an impression from the second half of the field. Doubt she'll be as far back and need to do as much to win here. Currimundi is a good roughie. He ran well at odds over the mile last start but I don't think the drop in trip is a bad thing. Maps to get every chance in the run. Silent Diva  is a nice horse with a fair bit of upside. Bit of a non event for Refamme No Angel last start when a short favourite. She had no luck at all in the straight. I'm potentially underrating her as it'd be no shock to see her win with authority.

bestBets.overview: TOO DARDY comes into this off back-to-back feature wins. He will stalk the speed from his middle draw and go close if he can hold his current form. CORRECT CHOICE is a horse on the rise and attacks this fresh with the benefit of a trial win. ROYAL TORONADO is a talented type who has trialled very well ahead of his return. This is well short of his preferred trip but I'm expecting him to run well with Pike aboard. GINGER BAKER has claims despite the weight.

raceTips.comment: Ginger Baker is ticking along well this prep without winning. He's been racing in stakes grade all throughout the campaign and this is probably close to the weakest one he's faced as the majority of his rivals are all up in class for this assignment. He's shown he can lead in the past but I see him settling around midfield with Lucy Fiore needing a bit of luck in the straight. If she gets it, the horse will take beating. Royal Toronado has won out to 2200m, but 1400m suits first up. The recent trial indicates he's set for a fruitful prep. Charino deserves a crack at this level. He's in career best form having won three of his past four starts - all of which have been at this track. Sensessional can win this on best form but it's been a while since he's won. He boasts an outstanding record at Belmont.

ROYAL TORONADO resumed at 1200m last preparation at Ascot and ran a faster L600, 400 & 200 than now dual Listed sprinter Immortal Bliss. His recent Lark Hill trial was brilliant and this really does look a nice race for him first-up at 1400 on the 54kg minimum. He’s a 6-year-old but get the feeling he’s just getting better and better with racing and in a race with only a moderate tempo on paper he shouldn’t be too far off them on straightening. TOO DARDY has won back to back 84+ features and deserves a crack at Listed Level. This is harder but he maps to get the run he needs. CHARINO has won three of his last five, is versatile and runs for Holly Nottle. They can ride him to suit any emerging track pattern.

bestBets.overview: SISU SPIRIT stepped up to a staying trip for the first time last start and ran a strong second behind a talented type. He just needs to replicate that effort to go very close again. HANAFUBUKI should be ready to run a race at her third run back from a spell. Expect her to park off the speed and find the line strongly. ROMMEO is rock-hard fit and racing well. STARWALKER is a last-start winner at this track and distance.

raceTips.comment: SISU SPIRIT had his first attempt at 2200m a fortnight ago and came through with flying colours. It was an ugly and messy race where they ran the first 1600m a staggering 17L slower than average so it wasn’t a true staying test but doubt that this will be either. Should land 1x1/1x2 and from there gets his opportunity. WARRALEA LASS was the one who tried the rack and stack tactics in that event but just couldn’t sprint away from rivals at the point of the home corner. SNAZZLER has come back to racing in good order. First-up caught the eye at 100-1 behind Heaven Specified, I Love Ya Money and Publicise under 61.5kg and second-up was still there fighting at 1600m with 200 to go behind The Crimson Pirate and Yes I Know. Quickly out to 2100m third-up but racing well. STARWALKER is an out and out stayer. 4 wins and 3 placings from 10 starts at 2000+.

Sisu Spirit is in great touch at the moment and it's hard to tip against him. He was 1600m up to 2200m last start and handled it well, beaten a head by a good stayer in With Discretion. Warralea Lass led and gave a good sight in that same race, finishing a length behind Sisu Spirit in third. No reason why she can't be competitive again and at double figure odds, she represents a bit of value. Miss Veuve had a clear excuse last start in a Northam race where the horses were bunched near the outside rail. She's steadily improved with each run this prep and looks ready to win now. Snazzler, Chollima and Starwalker go in the quaddie.
